$comment: Owner-registry index. Person records remain in people.json; campus assignments are resolved live. This file records completeness and review paths without duplicating personal data.

reviewCadence.campusRoles: live lookup; cached snapshot stale after seven days
reviewCadence.departmentRoles: monthly and after an announced ownership change
reviewCadence.systemOwners: quarterly and after an incident or deployment

n8nOwnershipGap.resolution: Protocol 1d: preserve the source/workflow route and ask the website agent operator to resolve the missing owner. This is coordination, not an assignment of n8n technical ownership.
